status: Three design concepts awaiting user approval before menu integration and state generation.

concepts.name: Low paper pallet
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: MENU BUTTON DESIGN CONCEPT 1 OF 3 — "LOW PAPER PALLET" — transparent pixel-art button sprite for The Picture Shop.
Input 1 is the approved cutter title control: match its shaded pixel art, black edges, warm ivory layered paper and bold dark serif printed title. Input 2 is the game's loaded paper pallet: use the actual warm wood slats, nails, support blocks and fork openings, not metal framing.
Create ONE isolated wide low button shaped as a REAL WOODEN PALLET CARRYING A THICK PAPER STACK, about3.2:1 overall silhouette. Use a shallow elevated FRONT view with horizontal front edge and only gentle perspective, so a horizontal menu label remains large and readable.
A honey-brown slatted timber pallet with three chunky support blocks and two dark fork-entry openings forms the entire bottom. A neat, broad cream paper ream sits physically on its deck. Clearly visible fine layered paper edges along the front and sides, slightly offset top sheet, subtle paper thickness. Warm wood grain and small dark nail heads, restrained wear, crisp outlines. The top paper face takes most of button width and provides calm empty space.
Print EXACTLY "New Shop" in large bold charcoal serif type on the center of the TOP PAPER SURFACE, like the printed title on the approved cutter. No dark title box, no metal border, no icons or additional words. Label printed on paper, not pallet.
Button feels tactile, broad, clean and usable at small game-menu size, not a giant square shipping load. The pallet's silhouette and fork pockets must remain plainly recognizable.
Source-matched shaded pixel art, same apparent lighting as cutter title, creamy paper, amber-brown wood, dark charcoal ink. No machine on the button, no GUI frame, no standing scene, no legs beyond pallet blocks, no floor shadow.
True transparent alpha outside sprite, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no concept captions. ONE finished concept, not a grid or state sheet.

concepts.name: Strapped paper shipment
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: MENU BUTTON DESIGN CONCEPT 2 OF 3 — "STRAPPED PAPER SHIPMENT" — one transparent pixel-art menu-button sprite.
Input1 is the approved Polar cutter title control, matching paper, ink, black contours, metal/brass accents and shaded pixel-art rendering. Input2 is the existing loaded-paper pallet, matching warm timber, slats, block supports and forklift pockets.
Make a noticeably different alternative to a simple loose paper ream: one compact WIDE SHIPPING PALLET carrying a dense PAPER BUNDLE secured with two narrow industrial charcoal straps at its FAR LEFT AND FAR RIGHT ends. The straps wrap over paper edges and down the sides with small brass-toned buckle details near the pallet deck. They must leave the big central paper face perfectly open.
Composition about3.2:1 width:height, shallow elevated front THREE-QUARTER view, horizontal front timber edge, modest visible right-side depth. Recognizable wooden slats, three sturdy support blocks, two dark fork slots, tiny nails, subtle amber-brown wood grain. The ivory paper bundle is thicker than a few sheets but keep the control low and wide, not a tall cube. Slight raised lip of top paper sheet and crisp layered side edges, pressed tightly into one shipment.
Hero label is PRINTED directly on the cream top/front-facing paper label surface in large bold dark serif type that matches the approved cutter paper: EXACTLY "New Shop". No separate dark rectangle, no metal frame, no extra lettering or icons. Centered ample readable space, label dominates without covering straps. A small clean paper delivery tag tucked near the right buckle may be BLANK and subordinate.
Strong tactile shipping-load identity, clean organized industrial design, subtle brass tie-in to cutter clamp, warm wooden silhouette. This is an actual paper-loaded pallet transformed into a button, not a pallet illustration beside a generic button.
Source-like shaded pixel art, hard dark outlines, creamy paper, wood, charcoal webbing and tiny aged-brass highlights. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette, no backdrop, floor, external shadow or checkerboard. No captions or concept numbers. ONE finished concept only.

concepts.name: Pallet job ticket
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: MENU BUTTON DESIGN CONCEPT 3 OF 3 — "PALLET JOB TICKET" — one transparent pixel-art game-button sprite.
Input1 is the approved cutter title control; directly match its layered ivory paper, large dark serif printing, shaded pixel art and crisp black edges. Input2 is the game's paper-loaded timber pallet; use its actual wood slats, nail heads, support blocks and dark fork-entry pockets.
Design one creative wide low PAPER PALLET BUTTON, about3.2:1, front-facing with gently elevated view. A warm wooden pallet carries two shallow slightly offset stacks of neatly cut paper. They form subtle stepped layers behind ONE oversized ivory JOB SHEET lying over their top and bending downward toward the viewer along the front paper edge. This job sheet creates the label face; its upper-right corner has a small natural curl exposing the sheet below, and its lower edge is slightly uneven/staggered, like a loose work-order page ready at the cutter. A TINY brass paper clamp centered at the rear edge holds the sheet, visually echoing the approved cutter's clamp rail, without becoming a clipboard.
Print EXACTLY "New Shop" very large in bold charcoal serif on the broad central sheet, high contrast and horizontal readability. The title is ink ON PAPER, no dark box or timber plaque. Below the words a single thin subtle printer's rule may suggest a job ticket, with no extra text or numerical fields.
Keep the job sheet above the two fork pockets so the PALLET remains clearly visible. The deck's warm timber slats and nails show on left and right, three sturdy timber blocks and two open fork channels show below. Label dominates the central paper; paper stack sides have delicate grey layered edges and staggered sheet corners. Just a couple tiny trimmed paper strips tucked along the right deck, no clutter.
Distinct from a tidy ream and a strapped shipment: asymmetrical loose job-sheet silhouette, curled corner, stepped paper layers and tiny brass clamp, tactile print-shop personality.
Beautiful source-matched shaded pixel art, crisp dark contours, warm ivory and charcoal print, honey-brown wood, subtle aged brass accent. Wide button proportions, ample label space, no shipping straps, no metal frame, no machine, no background/floor/external shadow/checkerboard. Genuinely transparent alpha outside silhouette. No concept captions or extra words. ONE finished concept.
